settings.heading: Growing Instructions
settings.content: Sow seeds directly outdoors after last frost, or start indoors 6-8 weeks before transplanting. Plant 1/4 inch deep in well-draining, fertile soil. Water regularly and thin seedlings to 12 inches apart when 2 inches tall.
